text: My office received a petition from Appleton Avenue residents requesting that parking be affixed to the east side of the street between December 1st and March 31st, and that alternate side parking remain as is, between April 1st and November 30th. By making this change through this motion, residents will gain an additional 7 on-street parking spaces during the winter months, which will alleviate parking pressures made challenging by snow.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking regulations in the attached Appendix “A”. 2. Enacted the parking regulations in the attached Appendix “B”.
